Ruby's `normalizer.call(value)` (normalization.rb:145) reads the Proc attribute with no arguments and invokes it through Proc#call; a JS function IS the callable, so `normalizedType.normalizer(value)` lands Ruby's Proc#call arguments on the attribute read — Function.prototype.call would rebind `this` to the value. RFC 0099 bucket: Ruby Proc#call, no TS spelling that keeps both call sites.
